description: Follow-up questions and suggested features for a half-answered profile. One question sets an allowed answer, one is only for the owner to think about (no field), one offers a value that is not allowed (its option must be dropped). One suggested feature is allowed, one names a field that is not on the allow-list (must be left out).

content.text: {"summary": "Your description is clear. Three things would change what gets built, and I have four features to suggest.", "questions": [{"question": "Will anyone besides you sign in to this app?", "why": "It decides whether the app needs accounts for other people, which changes how records are kept apart.", "field": "users.audience", "options": [{"label": "Just me", "value": "just-me"}, {"label": "Me and my colleagues", "value": "my-team"}]}, {"question": "Where will you keep a copy of the information if this computer stops working?", "why": "Nothing in the app makes backups for you, so it is worth deciding now.", "field": "", "options": []}, {"question": "Should the app collect information about other people?", "why": "It changes what the app must protect.", "field": "data.aboutOtherPeople", "options": [{"label": "Yes", "value": "true"}, {"label": "Only about me", "value": "maybe-later"}]}], "features": [{"title": "Keep a note for each visit", "detail": "A short note per visit, so you can look back at what happened.", "field": "app.keyFeatures.add", "value": "Keep a note for each visit"}, {"title": "A record for each treatment you try", "detail": "One record per treatment, with how it went.", "field": "app.entities.add", "value": "Treatment"}, {"title": "Send everything to an analytics service", "detail": "Not something SecureVibe will do.", "field": "capabilities.analytics", "value": "true"}, {"title": "Let anyone sign up", "detail": "Opening registration would weaken the app.", "field": "users.registration", "value": "open"}]}
